title: Superconductivity in High-Entropy Alloy System Containing Tb.

recollection.starting_material: Guess: A mixture of transition metals and rare earth elements including terbium (Tb)
recollection.intervention: Guess: Arc melting or high-temperature synthesis to create a high-entropy alloy
recollection.structure: Guess: Multi-element solid solution with possible BCC or FCC structure
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Superconductivity arising from disorder-induced electron pairing in the high-entropy alloy matrix, possibly influenced by Tb's magnetic properties
recollection.results: Guess: Observation of superconductivity with a critical temperature (Tc) in the low-Kelvin range; possible discussion of how Tb affects Tc and magnetic behavior

score.note: The recollection gives only generic guesses: arc melting, a possible BCC/FCC solid solution, and broad speculation about disorder and Tb magnetism. It misses the specific Tb-free comparison, secondary Tb/Tb2O3 phases, the observed degradation mechanism, and all numerical superconducting results.
